title: Babbling Bobtail Squid
statement: Hovering in indigo twilight above a garden of frosted sea glass and book-like basalt slabs, this teacup-sized cephalopod greets visitors by rippling glowing, punctuation-shaped spots across its velvety skin. Endlessly curious, it spends its days meticulously rearranging shiny pebbles on the tank floor as if drafting and redrafting a very important underwater novel.
